title: An import row with no description keeps the part's description
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete', See Financial Data and the Data Import setting.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODESC-01), with the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Keep Desc), is stocked at {Location-A} with Min 1 and Max 5, and 3 in its bin {Bin-A} (for example General Storage).
  • Import file {File-A} (for example ZZ-PL-NODESC.csv) holds one row: part number {Part-A}, an empty description, Min 2, Max 6, quantity 3 and Bin Location {Bin-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings → Data Import → Inventory.
  2. Upload {File-A}.
  3. Run the import.
  4. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  5. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the import finishes and does not refuse the row.
  • Step 4: one row, {Part-A}. Its Description still reads {Description-A}, not empty, and it now shows Min 2 and Max 6 (it had 1 and 5): the row was applied without emptying the description.
  • Step 5: the {Part-A} entry still shows Description {Description-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-N9, Story 7 context note (S7-N9), read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas: no board shows the parts import (13 Oct copy). Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 3). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-N9: “An import row with an empty description never empties a description. An existing Part Library entry keeps its description. A new entry takes its part number as its description.”
  • PRD Story 7 context note (S7-N9): “Context note (S7-N9): before this change, a blank description in an import file emptied an existing entry's description and saved a new entry with none. S7-N9 replaces that.”
